title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E09 — Tuna 101: Grilled, Poached and Raw
Chef Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole tuna and serves it three ways: grilled, raw, and poached.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E05 — The King of Open-Fire Paella
Andrew Zimmern showcases quail two ways: classic Southern fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, and as an elevated topping for a traditional open-fire paella, complete with crispy socarrat. He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E09 — Wild Seafood Risotto
Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies working with live sea urchin and scallops by creating a showstopping seafood risotto.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E06 — Minnesota's Foraged Mushroom Feast
Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests for wild mushrooms. He creates a simple grilled mushroom salad, then hand-shapes cavatelli pasta tossed with golden chanterelles, butter, garlic, thyme, and colatura. He shares foraging and cleaning tips.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E10 — The Ultimate Elk Tailgate
It's an elk tailgate over live fire. Andrew makes chorizo-spiced elk meatballs with queso fundido and red chile salsa, then cooks hay-smoked elk chops with charred alliums and black garlic-juniper butter.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E02 — Back to Our Caveman Roots
Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E10 — Wild Boar Feast: Chorizo with Mussels and Whole Roasted Leg
Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. Then, he slow-roasts a whole leg over fire, served Southern-style with pickled cherries, glazed onions & mustard sauce.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E05 — Bison Brats & Grilled Kebabs on Flatbread
Andrew butchers a whole bison leg before diving in to grinding meat for bison brats, grilling them up and topping with homemade spicy mustard. Then, he grills Middle Eastern-inspired kebabs to serve over flatbread for a feast built for sharing.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E02 — Carne Adovada
Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Carne Adovada.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E01 — The Best Fish You're Not Eating
Andrew takes on "little fish, big fish," cooking grilled whole small fish over Japanese charcoal with sesame spinach, and a larger fish in a bold puttanesca-style dish. Simple techniques, big flavor, and a case for eating lower on the food chain.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E07 — Grilled Clams Casino and Garlicky Clam Pizza
Andrew Zimmern celebrates cherrystone clams with two show-stopping recipes. He prepares classic grilled clams casino with pancetta, then pushes boundaries with an innovative grilled pizza topped with clams, garlic, chiles, and cheese.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E05 — Yakitori-Style Skewers and Pheasant Flatbread
Andrew butchers a whole pheasant to make yakitori-style skewers and a homemade flatbread, cucumber salad and a mango chutney.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E02 — Grilled Yellowtail Collars & Filets with Miso Sauce
Andrew cooks yellowtail two ways: grilled collars with a sweet, savory Filipino-inspired adobo sauce, and grilled filets with miso sauce, shiso butter, and charred vegetables. A lesson in using the whole fish and getting more from every cut.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E01 — Grilled Squid Salad and Crispy Squid on the Plancha
Andrew Zimmern creates a vibrant salad where grilled squid is served with shaved fennel, cherry tomatoes, endive, and a lemon dressing. Then, Andrew shares his country-style squid on the plancha with fresh breadcrumbs, chilies, and a homemade aioli.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E01 — The Essence of Grill Culture
Chef Andrew Zimmern makes two different dishes with red snapper: fried snapper fingers with a spicy chile-orange mayonnaise dipping sauce and a slow-roasted whole fish with a herb salad and charred miso sweet potatoes.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E09 — Southern Shrimp Skewers and Asian Crispy Rice
Andrew Zimmern grills beloved shrimp in two distinct ways. He starts with jumbo shrimp and country ham skewers glazed with sweet-hot pepper jelly. Then, he creates Asian-inspired shrimp, served over crispy basmati rice and a complex sambal.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E07 — The Wild Boar Playbook
Andrew turns wild boar into the ultimate game-day spread with boar and black bean chili topped with crisp cornbread waffles, and pulled boar sliders braised low and slow in Carolina Gold mustard sauce.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E05 — Yakitori-Style Skewers and Pheasant Flatbread
Andrew butchers a whole pheasant to make yakitori-style skewers and a homemade flatbread, cucumber salad and a mango chutney.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E02 — Grilled Yellowtail Collars & Filets with Miso Sauce
Andrew cooks yellowtail two ways: grilled collars with a sweet, savory Filipino-inspired adobo sauce, and grilled filets with miso sauce, shiso butter, and charred vegetables. A lesson in using the whole fish and getting more from every cut.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E01 — Grilled Squid Salad and Crispy Squid on the Plancha
Andrew Zimmern creates a vibrant salad where grilled squid is served with shaved fennel, cherry tomatoes, endive, and a lemon dressing. Then, Andrew shares his country-style squid on the plancha with fresh breadcrumbs, chilies, and a homemade aioli.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E07 — The Wild Boar Playbook
Andrew turns wild boar into the ultimate game-day spread with boar and black bean chili topped with crisp cornbread waffles, and pulled boar sliders braised low and slow in Carolina Gold mustard sauce.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E09 — Game Day Chicago-Style Beef Sandwich
Andrew builds a massive Chicago-style fried beef sandwich with peppers, onions and molten cheese before tackling true snout-to-tail cooking: a whole simmered cow head transformed into crispy tacos de cabeza with two salsas.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E07 — Striped Bass Crudo and Smoky Summer Succotash
Chef Andrew Zimmern celebrates summer's bounty with an elegant bass crudo and a whole roasted striped bass topped with a herb-packed compound butter and served alongside a smoky corn succotash studded with charred poblanos.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E08 — Nashville Hot Pheasant and Mint Basil Lemonade
Chef Andrew Zimmern takes a spin on Nashville-style hot fried chicken. Hot and spicy, batter coated, crispy fried pheasant is paired with a spinach salad topped with bacon vinaigrette and ice-cold mint basil lemonade.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E10 — Hawaiian Plate Lunch
Andrew Zimmern reimagines the Hawaiian plate lunch with a hand chopped venison burger topped with homemade gravy and a fried egg, jumbo grilled shrimp, a humble macaroni salad and a heaping scoop of white rice.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E03 — Venison Paillard and Hearty Hunter's Stew
Andrew Zimmern showcases venison two ways: a delicate grilled paillard with artichokes and Parmesan, and a rich, slow-braised Polish hunter's stew with kielbasa, mushrooms, and sauerkraut. Served with grilled leeks and coal-roasted potatoes.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E01 — Grilled Turkey Legs, Creamed Greens and Lemon Orzo
Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Grilled Turkey Legs, Creamed Greens and Lemon Orzo.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E02 — Poultry Perfection: Moroccan Spiced Guinea Hen with Charred Vegetables
Andrew unlocks the rich flavor of guinea hen with a vibrant grilled salad featuring watercress and a mustard-hazelnut vinaigrette. Then, he slow-roasts a whole bird with Middle Eastern spices, served with harissa squash and eggplant-tahini purée.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E08 — Crispy Duck Noodle Soup
Andrew Zimmern transforms wild duck into a simple grilled appetizer inspired by Japanese tataki and then uses the rest of the duck to make open fire duck noodle soup with fresh egg noodles, lots of aromatic herbs, bean sprouts and a squeeze of lime.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E04 — Grilled Rabbit with Panzanella Salad
Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole rabbit to grill with a spicy, Sichuan sauce and plate with panzanella.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E05 — Creamy Clam Chowder and Mussels in Spicy Tomato Sauce
Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies cooking clams, mussels and oysters.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E07 — Goat Curry with Rice Pilaf and Carmelized Onions
Chef Andrew butchers a whole goat, using the leg and backstrap for a braised curry.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E04 — Bison Tomahawk Chop with Italian-style Eggplant and Panzanella
Chef Andrew Zimmern shares a simple trick for getting the most out of bison tomahawk chops.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S01 E06 — Vegetables, but Delicious
Chef Dale crafts a family style platter of trumpet mushrooms, eggplant marinated in spicy ssam jang, and charred yellow squash served with a green goddess dressing.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S04 E02 — Yakitori and More-Y
Don't sleep on grilled chicken, especially if it's Chef Dale night to cook! He's serving up Japanese style yakitori three ways, from spicy to sweet to zesty, with crispy rice, and of course he adds his own flair to these delicious skewered snacks.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S04 E07 — Street Eats off the Grill
Japan, Thailand, Turkey, and Mexico street foods inspire Dale to grill with dynamically preparing Chili-Cuman Lamb Mushroom sticks, Grilled pork and shrimp shumai, and scallion pancakes with brown butter labneh.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S05 E01 — Ribs Remix
Ribs are a lifestyle, and Chef Dale's living it up with smoky beef shorties in tangy red wine glaze, Miami-style pork ribs dripping in bacon-guava BBQ, spicy baked beans, and killer key lime caramel cones. Grab some napkins!

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S03 E15 — Pizzapalooza
Chef Dale Talde grills a Chicago-style pie, pepperoni pizza pocket, chicken wings, and a zesty grilled Caesar.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S05 E07 — Pizza-Town
Dale reinvents pizza night: grilled pizza bagels loaded with pepperoni, mozzarella-stuffed penne vodka pie, a massive grilled chop salad, and olive oil cake with burnt orange caramel. Pizza goals achieved.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S03 E04 — Luxe Lobster & Prime Rib
Chef Dale Talde pulls out all the stops for this daddy-sized dinner. He grills up prime rib with herb & horseradish crust, lobster & chili sauce American, charred green beans with garlic tahini, and cheddar-stuffed parker house rolls.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S04 E01 — The Art of Open Fire Cooking
Chef Dale goes back to the roots of cooking, building a grill over an open fire to serve up a variety of dishes, including whole smoked chicken and fish, roasted cauliflower, a sweet and tangy grilled pineapple s'more dessert.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S03 E14 — Family-Friendly BBQ
Chef Dale Talde creates a tasty menu that kids & parents alike will love! Apple pancakes with coconut brown butter syrup, grilled cheese & tomato soup, cheesy chicken parm, and a sticky s'mores dessert round out the full day of deliciousness.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S01 E02 — It's Taco Time
Tacos are the way to Chef Dale's heart, and he's grilling up a sweet and smoky lemongrass and guajillo pork with pineapple, served with coconut and cotija cheese corn and an avocado jicama salad.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S05 E05 — Kabob-alicious
Dale skewers ribeye, salmon, smoky eggplant dip, and grilled peaches. Food on sticks never tasted better!

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S03 E09 — Scrumptious Summer Sandwiches
Chef Dale Talde channels his inner sandwich lover by making an angry lobster club with pepper aioli and grilled bacon, a lamb birria torta with avocado and ramen consommé, and an Italian beef combo with chili crisp cheese sauce, giardiniera.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S05 E03 — The Heat Is On
Dale's turning up the heat! Carolina Reaper wings hotter than your ex, sweet-chili NY strip steak, smoky grilled chipotle Texas toast, and ancho-gochujang pineapple skillet cake for dessert. Bring some water!

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S03 E08 — Grilled Chicken 3 Ways
Chef Dale Talde amps up your chicken dishes by making smoky chicken wings, a whole roasted turmeric ginger chicken with tamarind sauce, and chicken patties grilled in banana leaves with chili lime noodles. A frosty lime rickey finishes it all off!

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S01 E03 — Restaurant-Style Whole Roast Fish
Chef Dale grills to impress with restaurant quality meal of whole roasted fish, coconut milk grits, and snow pea, watermelon and tamarind salad.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S02 E08 — Sunday Vietnamese Brisket with Noodles
Chef Dale Talde shows us how he does Sunday up right as he grills up some Vietnamese Brisket with Rice Noodles, Crispy Swordfish Summer Rolls, and tops it all off with some tasty Soju Floats. Hey, it's Sunday somewhere, right?

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S03 E01 — Beer Brats & BBQ Ribs
Chef Dale Talde grills up summer favorites perfect for any backyard BBQ. Cheddar beer brats in a pretzel bun, BBQ lamb ribs with Chinese mustard sauce, watermelon lime soju punch, & warm donuts with grilled strawberries & whipped cream for dessert.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S01 E05 — Brunch on the Grill
Chef Dale greets the day with a Dutch baby pancake and tangerine syrup, crispy hash browns topped with crème fraîche and roe, and a ham steak smothered in sweet cherry mostarda and red eye gravy.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S04 E04 — Caribbean Latin BBQ
Comforting and familiar but full of island flavor, right from the grill! Chef Dale roasts pork shoulder with chicharrones, steamy coconut rice and pigeon peas finished with frozen coconut rum drink with a charred banana.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S03 E02 — Bougie Badass Burgers
Chef Dale Talde brings your basic burgers to a new level with his dry-aged beef burger with potatoes and truffle Dijon mayo, a part-beef part-pork belly burger with cheddar & an egg, and lastly a crispy mushroom tortilla burger with salsa & cheese.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S03 E09 — Scrumptious Summer Sandwiches
Chef Dale Talde channels his inner sandwich lover by making an angry lobster club with pepper aioli and grilled bacon, a lamb birria torta with avocado and ramen consommé, and an Italian beef combo with chili crisp cheese sauce, giardiniera.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S05 E02 — Bussin' Burgers
Chef Dale is flipping burgers into art - gooey mac & cheeseburgers, fancy French patties topped with melty bucheron cheese, crispy parm-truffle fries, and peanut butter fudge ice cream sandwiches. Get hungry.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S05 E04 — Tandoor On The Grill
Dale fires up the tandoor grill, turning out juicy chicken thighs, smoky shrimp with Old Bay yogurt, crispy cauliflower, and a silky mango lassi dessert topped with crunchy candied pistachios. Tandoori done right!

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S03 E03 — Feast of Killer Crab & Perfect Pork Belly
Chef Dale Talde prepares a finger food feast with char grilled chili crab, spiced adobo potatoes, grilled pork belly, & sofrito stuffed branzino all served on a bed of rice over banana leaves. Call your friends - this is a feast that will feed many!

title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
description:
S01 E04 — These Smoked Turkey Legs are better than the State Fair
Kevin and Noah smoke up some State Fair Turkey Legs; fry some skillet Chorizo & Eggs; smoke-and-fry some Buffalo Rib Tips; and cook up some Sriracha and Garlic-Butter Grilled Shrimp.

title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
description:
S02 E05 — The Smoke-Reverse-Seared Cowboy Ribeye
It's Steak Day! We're making a Smoke-Reverse-Seared Cowboy Ribeye; Steak & Eggs; Carne Asada Tacos with Refried Beans and Charred Tomato Salsa; and a Grilled Pork Chop with a Peach Glaze.

title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
description:
S02 E02 — Southern Comfort: Oxtails, Collard Greens and Dirty Rice
We're cooking Smoked Oxtails; BBQ Oxtail Spaghetti; Cowboy Skillet Breakfast; Dirty Rice and Collard Greens.

title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
description:
S01 E01 — Beef Shank is the New Brisket
Kevin and Noah are smoking a humungous Thor's Hammer; cooking up some Catfish & Eggs for breakfast; making a Grilled Salsa Verde; and putting on a pot of Mezcal Charro Beans.

title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
description:
S01 E05 — The Only Pulled Pork Recipe You'll Ever Need
Kevin and Noah are smoking up some BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwiches with Coleslaw; frying up a skillet of Creole Cabbage; and charcoal-grilling some Steak Sandwiches with Chimichurri Mayo.

title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
description:
S02 E03 — Every Kind of Rib: Dino, Fried, Smoked, Grilled and Glazed
It's Rib Day on BBQ Smokeout! Noah and Kev are cooking Dino Beef Ribs, Fried St. Louis Pork Ribs, Smoked Pork Spare Ribs with a Hennessey Glaze, and Smoke-Grilled Baby Backs. Plus we're making good old fashioned Dirty Cabbage.

title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
description:
S01 E03 — Why LA's Danger Dog is the Best Thing You'll Ever Eat
Kevin & Noah make their twists on some L.A. outdoor classics: Backyard Burgers 2 Ways; Pit-Smoked Pollo Asado; Grilled Mexican Street Corn and Bacon-Wrapped Danger Dogs.

title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
description:
S02 E04 — Louisiana Style Crawfish Boil
It's Crawfish Boil Day on the show. Noah and Kev are making a gigantic Crawfish Boil; plus Smoked King Crab Legs; Grilled Rainbow Trout with Brown Butter and Grilled Lemon; and Kev's famous Red Beans and Rice.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E07 — Grilled Clams Casino and Garlicky Clam Pizza
Andrew Zimmern celebrates cherrystone clams with two show-stopping recipes. He prepares classic grilled clams casino with pancetta, then pushes boundaries with an innovative grilled pizza topped with clams, garlic, chiles, and cheese.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E08 — Tailgate Surf-and-Turf Po'Boy Sandwiches
Seafood takes center stage as Andrew fries shrimp, squid and small whole fish for Sicilian-style fritto misto, then layers crispy walleye and oysters into a fully dressed po'boy with savory beef gravy.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E08 — Nashville Hot Pheasant and Mint Basil Lemonade
Chef Andrew Zimmern takes a spin on Nashville-style hot fried chicken. Hot and spicy, batter coated, crispy fried pheasant is paired with a spinach salad topped with bacon vinaigrette and ice-cold mint basil lemonade.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E09 — Game Day Chicago-Style Beef Sandwich
Andrew builds a massive Chicago-style fried beef sandwich with peppers, onions and molten cheese before tackling true snout-to-tail cooking: a whole simmered cow head transformed into crispy tacos de cabeza with two salsas.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E04 — Grilled Rabbit with Panzanella Salad
Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole rabbit to grill with a spicy, Sichuan sauce and plate with panzanella.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E02 — Back to Our Caveman Roots
Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E05 — Creamy Clam Chowder and Mussels in Spicy Tomato Sauce
Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies cooking clams, mussels and oysters.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E06 — Grilled Eggplant Caponata Toast and Crispy Squab Katsu
Andrew Zimmern creates an elegant, seared pigeon toast crowned with a Sicilian caponata bursting with grilled eggplant, olives, and capers and a crispy pigeon katsu served with a refreshing shaved cabbage salad and punchy ginger-carrot vinaigrette.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E02 — Poultry Perfection: Moroccan Spiced Guinea Hen with Charred Vegetables
Andrew unlocks the rich flavor of guinea hen with a vibrant grilled salad featuring watercress and a mustard-hazelnut vinaigrette. Then, he slow-roasts a whole bird with Middle Eastern spices, served with harissa squash and eggplant-tahini purée.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E10 — Wild Boar Feast: Chorizo with Mussels and Whole Roasted Leg
Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. Then, he slow-roasts a whole leg over fire, served Southern-style with pickled cherries, glazed onions & mustard sauce.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E06 — Minnesota's Foraged Mushroom Feast
Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests for wild mushrooms. He creates a simple grilled mushroom salad, then hand-shapes cavatelli pasta tossed with golden chanterelles, butter, garlic, thyme, and colatura. He shares foraging and cleaning tips.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E07 — The Wild Boar Playbook
Andrew turns wild boar into the ultimate game-day spread with boar and black bean chili topped with crisp cornbread waffles, and pulled boar sliders braised low and slow in Carolina Gold mustard sauce.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E04 — Bison Tomahawk Chop with Italian-style Eggplant and Panzanella
Chef Andrew Zimmern shares a simple trick for getting the most out of bison tomahawk chops.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E03 — The Most Underrated Game Bird
Goose, one of Andrew's favorite game birds, is prepared two ways: a French onion soup-style grilled breast sandwich with caramelized onions and melted cheese, and a whole bird, cured, roasted on a beer can, and served with an apple-fennel salad.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E08 — Crispy Duck Noodle Soup
Andrew Zimmern transforms wild duck into a simple grilled appetizer inspired by Japanese tataki and then uses the rest of the duck to make open fire duck noodle soup with fresh egg noodles, lots of aromatic herbs, bean sprouts and a squeeze of lime.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E04 — Mediterranean Grilled Filets and Salt Crusted Halibut
Andrew Zimmern elevates California halibut, first with grilled fillets on saffron labneh with romesco and roasted cabbage. Then, he demonstrates a classic salt-crusted whole halibut, served with whole roasted cauliflower and a rich cream sauce.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E10 — The Ultimate Elk Tailgate
It's an elk tailgate over live fire. Andrew makes chorizo-spiced elk meatballs with queso fundido and red chile salsa, then cooks hay-smoked elk chops with charred alliums and black garlic-juniper butter.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E09 — Wild Seafood Risotto
Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies working with live sea urchin and scallops by creating a showstopping seafood risotto.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E09 — Tuna 101: Grilled, Poached and Raw
Chef Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole tuna and serves it three ways: grilled, raw, and poached.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E07 — Goat Curry with Rice Pilaf and Carmelized Onions
Chef Andrew butchers a whole goat, using the leg and backstrap for a braised curry.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E05 — Bison Brats & Grilled Kebabs on Flatbread
Andrew butchers a whole bison leg before diving in to grinding meat for bison brats, grilling them up and topping with homemade spicy mustard. Then, he grills Middle Eastern-inspired kebabs to serve over flatbread for a feast built for sharing.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E05 — Yakitori-Style Skewers and Pheasant Flatbread
Andrew butchers a whole pheasant to make yakitori-style skewers and a homemade flatbread, cucumber salad and a mango chutney.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E10 — Hawaiian Plate Lunch
Andrew Zimmern reimagines the Hawaiian plate lunch with a hand chopped venison burger topped with homemade gravy and a fried egg, jumbo grilled shrimp, a humble macaroni salad and a heaping scoop of white rice.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E06 — Braised Pigeon with Homemade Herb Gnocchi
Chef Andrew Zimmern cooks braised squab with olives and vinegar, a perfect meal for a fall evening.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E02 — Carne Adovada
Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Carne Adovada.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E01 — Grilled Turkey Legs, Creamed Greens and Lemon Orzo
Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Grilled Turkey Legs, Creamed Greens and Lemon Orzo.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E10 — Holy Mackerel!
Andrew Zimmern champions the often-overlooked mackerel with a main salad of pickled filets, charred tomatoes, grilled frisée, and sweet summer peaches. Then, he grills it whole seasoned with caramelized onions, rutabaga mash and charred grapes.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E08 — Elk Tenderloin Tostadas and Grilled Rack of Ribs
Andrew Zimmern highlights lean elk, first crafting classic Mexican tostadas with grilled tenderloin, avocado, and homemade salsa macha. Then, he grills a whole rack of elk, serving it with creamy colcannon, tarragon emulsion, and rosemary charcoal.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E03 — A Whole Roasted Hog
For pig roast perfection, Chef Andrew Zimmern marinates a whole hog.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E03 — Tailgate Tacos and Bison Bolognese
Chef Andrew Zimmern starts simmering a classic Italian Bolognese sauce, with ground bison, lots of red wine and tomatoes. Then, he adds marinated bison skirt steak tacos with borracho beans to the tailgate menu.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E02 — Grilled Yellowtail Collars & Filets with Miso Sauce
Andrew cooks yellowtail two ways: grilled collars with a sweet, savory Filipino-inspired adobo sauce, and grilled filets with miso sauce, shiso butter, and charred vegetables. A lesson in using the whole fish and getting more from every cut.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E05 — The King of Open-Fire Paella
Andrew Zimmern showcases quail two ways: classic Southern fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, and as an elevated topping for a traditional open-fire paella, complete with crispy socarrat. He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E09 — Southern Shrimp Skewers and Asian Crispy Rice
Andrew Zimmern grills beloved shrimp in two distinct ways. He starts with jumbo shrimp and country ham skewers glazed with sweet-hot pepper jelly. Then, he creates Asian-inspired shrimp, served over crispy basmati rice and a complex sambal.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E01 — The Essence of Grill Culture
Chef Andrew Zimmern makes two different dishes with red snapper: fried snapper fingers with a spicy chile-orange mayonnaise dipping sauce and a slow-roasted whole fish with a herb salad and charred miso sweet potatoes.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E07 — Striped Bass Crudo and Smoky Summer Succotash
Chef Andrew Zimmern celebrates summer's bounty with an elegant bass crudo and a whole roasted striped bass topped with a herb-packed compound butter and served alongside a smoky corn succotash studded with charred poblanos.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S09 E08 — Super Sonoran
Pati makes three classic Sonoran recipes: a fish special called pescado zarandeado, a rich stew called gallina pinta and a tasty dirty rice with clams. In Sonora, she visits vacation destination Puerto Peñasco.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S09 E07 — Legends of the Sonoran Sea
Pati travels to Sonora's coast on the Sea of Cortez, where local legend Toño Contreras gives her a tour including shellfish on the beach, his restaurant Mariscos El Rey, and his home kitchen for some crave-worthy recipes.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S10 E02 — Food Meets Art
Pati explores some unique spots in Guadalajara where food and art truly connect. In her kitchen, she makes pollo a la valentina, rice with poblanos and corn, and an almond tres leches cake.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S09 E09 — Cooking for the Crew
Pati prepares a true Sonoran feast for the crew - Sonora cheese soup, chicken in pecan and ancho chile sauce.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S10 E05 — Jalisco Style Birria
Pati experiences the Escaramuza — An all-female horse riding and skills competition. In the kitchen, Pati makes Jalisco-style birria and her friend, pastry chef and cookbook author Fany Gerson, joins her to make gelatinas for dessert.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S10 E07 — Getting to the Roots
Pati meets the young chefs behind one of Guadalajara's most exciting restaurants, Xokol. Back home, Pati invites her friend Francisco Migoya over to make conchas to go with pellizcadas with chicharrón in salsa verde.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S10 E04 — Los Mariachis
Pati learns about the history, the instruments, and the meaning behind Mariachi music. Pati makes carne en su jugo, tres chiles guacamole, and masa berry shortcake.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S10 E01 — Welcome to Guadalajara
Pati explores the culinary highlights of Jalisco's capital city, Guadalajara. She starts at a street cart to taste the city's most iconic sandwich, tortas ahogadas. Then, she meets one of the city's best chefs, Fabian Delgado.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S09 E06 — Sonoran Family Favorites
Pati spends a day in the kitchen with her middle son, Sami, cooking recipes inspired by her travels in Sonora that she knows he'll love - beef and potato chimichangas, rice with lentils and caramelized onions, and an avocado and radish salad.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S10 E06 — Tradition and Innovation
Pati meets chef and historian Maru Toledo who is working to preserve and pass on some of Jalisco's most important regional recipes. Pati makes Jalisco-style chicken tamales and chile relleno rice dressed with salsa roja.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S09 E10 — Hacienda Ranch Food
Pati makes traditional tamales with corn, chiles, and cheese, and then for the main course, pork chops topped with a pickled grape salad. In Sonora, she visits a traditional hacienda, where she gets a true taste of Sonoran ranch food.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S10 E10 — Tacos and a Tostada
Pati celebrates everyone's favorite Mexican creation, the taco. In her kitchen, Pati creates a pair of Jalisco-inspired tacos and a Ceviche tostada that are sure to satisfy any true taco-lover.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S11 E07 — Cantina Culture and the Morning After?
Cantinas have historically been bars where men gather to drink and sing about their broken hearts. Historian David Canales takes Pati to historic locations. Then she tries the best tacos in town.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S12 E01 — The Nectar of the Mayan Gods
Pati is in the magic town of Maní to learn about something sacred to the Mayans - bees and honey. A group of women who protect the endangered Melipona, a stingless bee native to Yucatán, invites her to join in a Mayan energy cleansing ritual.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S11 E09 — A Day With Hugo
Chef Hugo Guajardo researches the best of Nuevo León's ingredients. He and Pati visit a family-owned restaurant that has perfected the art of drying meat. Then, she tries his famed charred chicken.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S11 E08 — Texas BBQ in the Orange Belt
Pati visits BBQ champion Luis Rivas to taste his Mexican take on Texas-style BBQ, and he hosts a traditional carne asada at his family's orange grove. Then Pati learns how Glorias candies are made.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S11 E05 — The Magic of Piloncillo
The Garza family invites Pati to their vineyard to help the community make piloncillo - and it's hard work! Then, in the magic town of Bustamante, three sisters make traditional bread in adobe ovens.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S11 E06 — Pioneering From Farm to Table
Gaby Molinar owns Huerto Urbano, an urban farm dedicated to providing Monterrey with nutritious, diverse local ingredients. And her husband is one of the region's greatest culinary pioneers.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S11 E02 — Sisters, Stew, and Sass
Two sisters made a little shack on the Rio Ramos into a must-visit restaurant known for one dish: cortadillo stew. Down the road, another restaurant uses traditional stews in their famous empalmes.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S11 E03 — The World Cup of Tacos
Nuevo León is divided between two pro soccer teams: Los Tigres and Los Rayados. Pati tries the food at each stadium with the teams' stars to determine who wins in the battle of tortas vs tacos.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S11 E01 — The Fire Kings
Gualberto "Weber" Elizondo surprised his family when his grilling hobby turned him into a local celebrity and internet sensation. Meanwhile, chef Chuy Villareal of Cara De Vaca wants the world to know that the north of Mexico isn't just carne asada.

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E04 — Not Your Nonna's Gnocchi and Meatballs
In this episode Jamie takes midweek meals up a notch, knocking out a flavour-packed, simple gnocchi supper and giant spicy meatballs full of delicious time-saving cheats, and turns a family favourite on its head with his upside-down fish pie.

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E06 — Jamie's Outrageously Good Pulled Pork
Jamie cooks two one-pan recipes that are ideal for busy lives: his take on shakshuka with asparagus, broccoli & harissa; and an outrageously good pulled pork that can be batched up, frozen and used in loads of meals whenever you're ready.

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E03 — Crispy Rolled Pork Belly and Risotto
Jamie shares more fabulous one-pan dishes: foolproof tray-baked salmon in a bag; super-easy tomato fritters that you can rattle out in a frying pan; and roasted rolled pork and a risotto that are BOTH cooked in the same casserole pan. Result!

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E05 — Sweet Potato Chilli and Homemade Nachos
Jamie shows us a delicious range of one-pan dishes: a super-speedy smashed lemongrass chicken; flavour-packed sweet potato chilli with homemade nachos; and a chocolate party tray cake with retro tinned-mandarin and buttercream filling.

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E07 — Salmon Pasta, a Loaded Burger, and Sticky Toffee Apple Buns!
Jamie cooks three one-pan recipes: smoked salmon pasta, a loaded beef burger, and sticky toffee apple buns.

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E08 — An Eggplant Burger, Seared Salmon, & Squash Casserole!
Jamie shares three easy one-pan wonders: an aubergine burger, sesame salmon, and chickpea & squash casserole!

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E01 — Weeknight Roast Lamb and Eggplant
Jamie kicks off his new one-pan series with a simplified and delicious frying-pan pasta, a clever twist on a fish pie that's full of flavour with none of the fuss, and a sublime roast lamb feast with a fantastic hack to speed up cooking.

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E02 — Speedy Chicken and Mushroom Puff Pastry Pie
Jamie cooks three one-pan recipes that provide a perfect solution for busy life: a superfast, flavour-packed smoky noodle soup; the cleverest homemade bread in a pan; and a chicken & mushroom pie with a time-saving tip for perfect pastry.
